comment: A42 C-first overlap probe for hero-triggered trap.c:trapeffect_dart_trap. A fresh Wizard with a distinct seed moves off the upstairs tile, places a dart trap on ordinary floor by wish, steps away, then crosses it and dismisses the effect. This is substantively distinct from v10's hostile-newt-triggered arrow trap: the hero is the target and the branch creates a dart, applies hero damage/poison, and may place it on the floor.
